summary: --font-body is defined on .shell, a descendant of body, so body never receives it; BODY_FONT token has no effect
evidence: App.svelte:31 style:--font-body on .shell; App.svelte:103 body font-family var(--font-body, ...); --font-body unused elsewhere
failure_scenario: body always uses the fallback system-ui; BODY_FONT (Segoe UI) is dead. Visible effect small on Windows (inferred).
